d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how President Cyril Ramaphosa is leading a high-level South African delegation of ministers, scientists, business leaders, and university students to Silicon Valley from November 15 to 21. The mission aims to attract artificial intelligence investment, explore frontier tech and data centre energy needs, and position South Africa as Africa’s premier digital hub. Kicking off at Semafor’s global forum and continuing at Stanford University, the visit comes at one of the most tense moments in US–South Africa relations in decades. Following US visa bans on…
